content.comment_body: Hello, I'm currently working with two 0-10V pressure sensors and want to display the difference between sensor 1 and sensor 2 to show the pressure differential. I've managed to calculate this value in my program using the analog comparator, but I can't figure out how to present it on my [product_name] Web Editor page. Any advice would be appreciated. Ideally, I'd also like to calculate flow based on this figure and display those results in the web editor, though I suspect this may go beyond what [product_name] is capable of. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to show calculated values, such as a pressure differential from two analog inputs, on their [product_name] Web Editor page. While they can compute the value in their program, it is unclear how to display it in the web interface. The user also wishes to include flow calculations, but is unsure if this is supported by [product_name]. Another community member recommends using Parameter-VM-Mapping to display data, indicating a solution the original poster may not be familiar with.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easy and straightforward way to present calculated analog data and related results, such as pressure differential and flow computations, on the [product_name] Web Editor page.
